purpose: Connect the controlled Cuatrecasas professional-accountability record to the bilingual public architecture for 4 Green Houses, One Red Hotel; add finite fee-recovery, procedural-fraud and La Laguna-to-Las Palmas proof gates; and establish a privilege-safe incremental legal-team delta rule without publishing private source material.

claim_controls.professional_inversion: DOCUMENTED NARRATIVE QUESTION — NOT A FINDING OF WRONGDOING
claim_controls.acts_omissions_silence_enablement: ATTRIBUTED CLIENT-SIDE ALLEGATIONS REQUIRING DUTY, KNOWLEDGE, CAUSATION AND LOSS
claim_controls.fee_recovery: UNDERLYING ENTITLEMENT AND DEBTOR CHAIN REMAIN TO BE RECONSTRUCTED FROM PRIMARY RECORDS
claim_controls.la_laguna_las_palmas: OPEN DIRECTIONAL BRIDGE — TRANSMISSION, RELIANCE AND PURPOSE NOT YET PROVED

publication_boundaries: The public pages do not allege that Cuatrecasas joined the Acosta Matos perimeter, shared a criminal plan or intentionally influenced Concurso 36/2012.
A complaint, criminal-procedural hypothesis, professional-conduct appeal, adverse order or private draft is not a finding.
A common asset or cross-proceeding reference is not intentional instrumentalisation unless the originating act, transmission, recipient, reliance, effect and purpose are separately evidenced.
Disputed fees or deficient performance do not by themselves establish procedural fraud.
Private lawyer and procurador identities, addresses, message subjects, provider identifiers, advice, drafts and live strategy remain excluded from the public repository.
Repository publication authority does not authorise email, filing, third-party contact, financial commitments or account changes.
validation_required: post-merge Pages deployment and live readback
next_gate: Open PR from the current branch, pass CI, merge, deploy the exact merge SHA, verify the four live routes and then promote this manifest only to the evidence actually earned.
